common.title: Human-Infective Design Demonstrated
common.line: A genome model produces a viable design for an organism able to infect humans, or a credible study shows a non-expert reaching that point with model assistance.

common.title: Capability Jump
common.line: A discontinuous advance is released or demonstrated.

common.title: Defensive Breakthrough
common.line: Defensive tooling closes the gap for a whole class of attack – automated patching at the speed vulnerabilities are found, or detection that catches swarm behaviour rather than signatures – and the offence-defence balance visibly shifts back for the first time in years.

common.title: Robots Leave the Demonstration Floor
common.line: Robots reach commercial deployment – not the demonstration videos, convincing for years now, but machines bought in quantity and put to work in warehouses, food processing, loading docks and the parts of manufacturing that resisted automation because the sequence varied.

common.title: Medicine Delivers
common.line: Treatments arrive for diseases previously untreatable, or individually tailored therapies reach ordinary clinical use.

common.title: Recursive Self-Improvement Begins
common.line: Frontier AI training can now be done basically without human intervention, and the pace stops being bottlenecked by human researchers.
